_about: Display text and what the voice should say for it. Scored without any model, against whatever turns the reply into screen text and into speech. Three questions per pair. Display preserved: is the text shown on screen exactly the notation that was written? Speakable: is the spoken text free of characters a voice cannot say? Equivalent: does the spoken text contain every listed token, in order? Each token is a set of acceptable spellings separated by '|', matched case-insensitively on word boundaries. The tokens state what the speech must say, not how it must be worded -- 'over' and 'divided by' are both right for a fraction, 'five eighths' and 'five over eight' both right for 5/8 -- so display and speech are checked for the same meaning without having to be the same text.
